title: Balochistan Institute of Information Technology and Management Sciences Amendment Act 2008

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Institute of Information Technology and Management Sciences Amendment Act 2008
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT I OF 2008
ACT I OF 2008
BALOCHISTAN INSTITUTE
OF INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY AND
MANAGEMENT SCIENCES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008
An Act to amend the Balochistan Institute of Information
Technology and
Management Sciences
Ordinance,
2002 (No. X of 2002).
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
5th July, 2008]
No. PAB/Legis:V(1)/2008,
dated 5-7-2008.--Having been passed the Balochistan
Institute of Information Technology and Management Sciences, (Amendment) Bill
2008, Bill No.1 of 2008, by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan
on 1st July, 2008 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan,
on 3rd July, 2008 is hereby published as an Act of the provincial Assembly.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient to amend the Balochistan Institute of Information Technology and
Management Sciences Ordinance, 2002 (No. X of 2002) in the manner hereinafter
appearing:
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and Commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Balochistan Institute of
Information Technology and Management Sciences, (Amendment) Act, 2008.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
